title: OCR Screen Snipping & Text Transcriber Pro
overview: A high-performance offline desktop screen snipping, optical character recognition (OCR), and text extraction tool engineered for researchers, developers, and data analysts. Features global hotkey triggers, borderless floating capture overlays, multi-engine OCR (Tesseract v5.3+ & RapidOCR ONNX), automated table/column structure reconstruction, instant clipboard injection, and regex pattern matching.
key_features: Global Hotkey & Floating Capture Overlay: Win32 global hotkey listener triggering a dynamic semi-transparent screen overlay with interactive click-and-drag selection box
Multi-Engine Local OCR Acceleration: Dual-engine fallback architecture utilizing static Tesseract v5.3+ binaries and RapidOCR ONNX models for sub-200ms text extraction
Layout Structure & Table Reconstruction: Bounding box spatial analysis algorithm that converts captured screen tables and multi-column text into formatted Markdown, TSV, or structured JSON
Instant Clipboard & History Inspector: Automatic copy-to-clipboard upon capture with a searchable local database history pane and regex pattern matchers (URLs, IPs, JSON, code snippets)
On-the-Fly Image Pre-Processing Pipeline: Automated image binarization, adaptive thresholding, and DPI upscaling via Pillow/OpenCV before passing rasters to OCR workers
Non-Blocking Async Worker Threads: Zero-latency capture overlay execution using isolated background worker threads and atomic queue polling at 30 Hz

core_stack.screen_capture: mss >= 9.0.0 & Pillow (ImageGrab) (Ultra-low latency screen frame buffer grabber)

typography.font_family: Segoe UI, Inter, Cascadia Code, sans-serif

system_architecture.pattern: Model-View-Controller (MVC) with Asynchronous Thread-Safe Event Queue
system_architecture.main_ui_thread: CustomTkinter 60 FPS event loop managing global overlay state, capture history grid, settings panel, and polling inter-thread queues at 30 Hz (33ms interval)
system_architecture.worker_threads: Background Python threads executing non-blocking stream & engine tasks
system_architecture.inter_thread_communication: Thread-safe queue.Queue delivering atomic telemetry payloads: ('HOTKEY_TRIGGERED'), ('CAPTURE_DONE', image_bytes, bbox), ('OCR_RESULT', text, table_tsv), ('ERROR', err_str)
system_architecture.process_safety: Thread-safe event queue passing, clean process tree termination, and memory safety
system_architecture.ui_thread: CustomTkinter main loop polling queue.Queue every 40ms for 60 FPS UI responsiveness

conversion_pipeline_optimization.binarization_pipeline: Apply Otsu adaptive thresholding and 2x Lanczos scaling to low-DPI screen region rasters before passing to OCR models
conversion_pipeline_optimization.table_reconstruction: Group text bounding boxes into horizontal lines and vertical columns based on spatial Euclidean centroid distance matrices
conversion_pipeline_optimization.binary_resolution: 5-Tier dynamic resolution for Tesseract binaries, ONNX model weights, and TESSDATA language packs

binary_resolution_order: Local AppData / Program Files default paths (C:\Program Files\Tesseract-OCR	esseract.exe)
User interactive manual binary file selection dialog
ai_agent_prompt:
You are an elite Senior Desktop Systems & Computer Vision Engineering Specialist tasked with implementing a production-grade native Windows desktop application titled 'OCR Screen Snipping & Text Transcriber Pro'.

### PROJECT OBJECTIVE:
Construct a zero-cloud, sub-200ms desktop tool that captures selected screen regions via global hotkeys, performs multi-engine OCR (Tesseract & RapidOCR ONNX), reconstructs table layouts, and injects clean text directly into the system clipboard.

### MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. DISTINCT UI & THEME (CYBERPUNK GOLD & ONYX MATRIX):
   - Implement a dark workspace using #090A0F (Background), #12141D (Panels), #1A1D2B (Cards), and #FFB800 (Cyber Gold Primary Accent).
   - Provide a responsive layout featuring an interactive history inspector, regex capture pattern matcher, engine config panel, and a borderless semi-transparent capture canvas.

2. GLOBAL HOTKEY & MULTI-MONITOR SCREEN CAPTURE:
   - Bind global OS hotkeys (e.g., Win+Shift+S or Ctrl+Alt+X) via keyboard listener.
   - Leverage mss for ultra-low latency frame grabs across multi-monitor DPI setups.

3. DUAL OCR ENGINE & SPATIAL TABLE RECONSTRUCTION:
   - Provide dual-engine execution: Tesseract v5.3+ (static binary) and RapidOCR ONNX runtime.
   - Implement bounding-box spatial clustering to reconstruct tables into TSV or Markdown.

4. CONCURRENCY & TELEMETRY:
   - Offload image pre-processing and OCR inference to worker threads (ThreadPoolExecutor).
   - Stream atomic updates to the main GUI thread via queue.Queue polled at 30 Hz.

5. RESILIENCE, BINARY RESOLUTION & PACKAGING:
   - Implement a 5-tier binary resolver for tesseract.exe and ONNX model weights.
   - Deliver a complete OCRSnippingToolPro.spec for PyInstaller packaging.
